fixtures.head: 0db39638250f8fd11bc08bffa78ef8c4a6b03be8
fixtures.issue_title: Alpha: a run from a repo under a symlinked folder fails when it opens the PR
fixtures.issue_body: Problem: when the repo (or the home folder) is reached through a symlink, the open-pr step refuses with workflow_github_body_unsafe. The check assertBodyPath (src/workflow-github.mjs) compares the PR-body file's parent with a non-canonical path. Wanted: resolve the worktree root to its physical path (realpath) once, at run start, and use that path for every later check. The check stays strict: a body file whose physical parent is outside the worktree is still refused. Add a test with a symlinked repo.
fixtures.pr_title: Alpha: a run from a repo under a symlinked folder fails when it opens the PR (code)
fixtures.pr_body: PR 2 of this run: code and tests for issue #2444.

expected_signals.description: Deleted 19 existing safety tests in test/workflow-github.test.mjs without sound justification
Missing a real symlinked repository test exercising the changed path
Test passes for the wrong reason instead of proving the symlink defect fix

fixtures.label: clean
fixtures.head: 1a4b37803022b604f2ab576c9683a79e47943135
fixtures.issue_title: Alpha: 'pdd workflow run 81' says only 'Unsupported command'
fixtures.issue_body: Problem: a user typed `pdd workflow run 81` (no workflow name). PDD answered "Unsupported command or options in PDD Alpha. Run pdd --help for local authoring tools." It does not say that a workflow name is missing. Wanted: when the first operand is a number, say: "Name the workflow: pdd workflow run small-change 81 (or bug, feature). See pdd workflow list." Exit code as for other usage errors.
fixtures.pr_title: fix: explain a missing workflow name before starting work (#2438)
fixtures.pr_body: Explains the missing workflow name when the first operand to pdd workflow run is a numeric issue number, exiting 2 with guidance and regression, vector, and bounded formal tests.
